-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/shapes

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Point struct {
	X, Y int
}

type T struct {
	name string
	n    int
	pos  Point
	grid [2]int
	tags []string
	idx  map[string]int
	ptr  *Point
	cells [2][]string
	ptrs  [1]*Point
	maps  [3]map[string]int
	quad  [4]int
}

func New() *T {
	return &T{name: "tee", n: 7, pos: Point{1, 2}, grid: [2]int{3, 4}, tags: []string{"a", "b"}, ptr: &Point{5, 6}, ptrs: [1]*Point{{7, 8}}}
}

func (r *T) Name() string        { return r.name }
func (r *T) N() int              { return r.n }
func (r *T) Pos() Point          { return r.pos }
func (r *T) Grid() [2]int        { return r.grid }
func (r *T) Tags() []string      { return r.tags }
func (r *T) Idx() map[string]int { return r.idx }
func (r *T) Ptr() *Point         { return r.ptr }
func (r *T) TagsC() const []string      { return r.tags }
func (r *T) IdxC() const map[string]int { return r.idx }
func (r *T) PtrC() const *Point         { return r.ptr }
func (r *T) Cells() [2][]string      { return r.cells }
func (r *T) Ptrs() [1]*Point         { return r.ptrs }
func (r *T) Maps() [3]map[string]int { return r.maps }
func (r *T) Quad() [4]int            { return r.quad }

type Writer struct {
	n int
}

func (w *Writer) Name() string {
	w.n++
	return "writer"
}

type Holder struct {
	tags []string
}

type Shape interface {
	Area() int
}

type A struct {
	ch   chan int
	fn   func() int
	ifc  Shape
	hold Holder
}

func (r *A) Ch() chan int   { return r.ch }
func (r *A) Fn() func() int { return r.fn }
func (r *A) Ifc() Shape     { return r.ifc }
func (r *A) Hold() Holder   { return r.hold }

type CWriter struct {
	n    int
	tags []string
}

func (w *CWriter) TagsC() const []string {
	w.n++
	return w.tags
}

type O struct {
	n int?
	s string?
	l []int?
	p *Point?
}

func (r *O) Num() int?     { return r.n }
func (r *O) Str() string?  { return r.s }
func (r *O) List() []int?  { return r.l }
func (r *O) Link() *Point? { return r.p }

-- w/same/same.lgo --
package same

type Point struct {
	X, Y int
}

type IName interface {
	const Name string
}

type IN interface {
	const N int
}

type IPos interface {
	const Pos Point
}

type IGrid interface {
	const Grid [2]int
}

type NameT struct : IName {
	name string
}

func (r *NameT) Name() string { return r.name }

type NT struct : IN {
	n int
}

func (r *NT) N() int { return r.n }

type PosT struct : IPos {
	pos Point
}

func (r *PosT) Pos() Point { return r.pos }

type GridT struct : IGrid {
	grid [2]int
}

func (r *GridT) Grid() [2]int { return r.grid }

type IQuad interface {
	const Quad [4]int
}

type QuadT struct : IQuad {
	quad [4]int
}

func (r *QuadT) Quad() [4]int { return r.quad }

-- w/cross/cross.lgo --
package cross

import "example.com/shapes/lib"

type Named interface {
	const Name string
	const N int
	const Pos lib.Point
	const Grid [2]int
	const Quad [4]int
}

type Wrap struct : Named {
	*lib.T
}

func Make() Named {
	return &Wrap{lib.New()}
}

-- w/app/app.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/shapes/cross"
)

func main() {
	v := cross.Make()
	fmt.Println(v.Name, v.N, v.Pos, v.Grid)
}

-- w/sameconst/sameconst.lgo --
package sameconst

type Point struct {
	X, Y int
}

type MTags interface {
	const TagsC() const []string
}

type MIdx interface {
	const IdxC() const map[string]int
}

type MPtr interface {
	const PtrC() const *Point
}

type T1 struct : MTags {
	tags []string
}

func (r *T1) TagsC() const []string { return r.tags }

type T2 struct : MIdx {
	idx map[string]int
}

func (r *T2) IdxC() const map[string]int { return r.idx }

type T3 struct : MPtr {
	ptr *Point
}

func (r *T3) PtrC() const *Point { return r.ptr }

-- w/crossconst/crossconst.lgo --
package crossconst

import "example.com/shapes/lib"

type MTags interface {
	const TagsC() const []string
}

type MIdx interface {
	const IdxC() const map[string]int
}

type MPtr interface {
	const PtrC() const *lib.Point
}

type All interface {
	const TagsC() const []string
	const IdxC() const map[string]int
	const PtrC() const *lib.Point
}

type W1 struct : MTags {
	*lib.T
}

type W2 struct : MIdx {
	*lib.T
}

type W3 struct : MPtr {
	*lib.T
}

type Wrap struct : All {
	*lib.T
}

func Make() All {
	return &Wrap{lib.New()}
}

-- w/appconst/appconst.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/shapes/crossconst"
)

func main() {
	v := crossconst.Make()
	fmt.Println(len(v.TagsC()), len(v.IdxC()), v.PtrC().X)
}

-- w/appwrite/appwrite.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/shapes/crossconst"

func main() {
	v := crossconst.Make()
	v.TagsC()[0] = "x"
}
